Usage: oci autoscaling policy [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Autoscaling policies define the criteria that trigger autoscaling actions
  and the actions to take.

  An autoscaling policy is part of an autoscaling configuration. For more
  information, see [Autoscaling].

  You can create the following types of autoscaling policies:

    - **Schedule-based:** Autoscaling events take place at the specific times
    that you schedule.   - **Threshold-based:** An autoscaling action is
    triggered when a performance metric meets or exceeds a threshold.

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  For detailed help on any of these individual commands, enter
                  <command> --help.
